details.description: Claude Mythos 5 is Anthropic's invitation-only counterpart to Claude Fable 5, released June 9, 2026 as part of Project Glasswing for defensive cybersecurity and biology research. It shares Claude Fable 5's underlying model, 1M-token context window, and 128K-token max output, but omits Fable 5's safety classifiers that can decline requests in sensitive domains. Access requires approval through Anthropic's, AWS's, or Google Cloud's account teams; Anthropic has since released Claude Mythos 5.1 (September 1, 2026) as the current model in this invitation-only line.
advantages: Removes the safety classifiers that Claude Fable 5 uses to decline requests involving cybersecurity, biology/chemistry, or suspected distillation, giving vetted users direct access to those capabilities, per Anthropic's model page.
Showed about 80% preference over Opus-class models in blinded comparisons of molecular biology hypotheses, per Anthropic's launch post.

Shares Claude Fable 5's frontier coding and agentic capabilities, including topping Cognition's FrontierCode evaluation and Hebbia's Finance Benchmark among frontier models, per Anthropic's launch post.
disadvantages: Restricted to invitation-only access through Project Glasswing; not available to general API users without approval from Anthropic, AWS, or Google Cloud account teams.
Superseded within the same invitation-only line by Claude Mythos 5.1, released September 1, 2026.
use_cases: Defensive cybersecurity vulnerability research for vetted security professionals under Project Glasswing
Biology and life-sciences research, including molecular biology hypothesis generation, for vetted researchers
Long-horizon agentic coding and enterprise research tasks shared with Claude Fable 5

notes: Catalog has no deprecation_date fact for this model; for reference, Anthropic's model-deprecations table lists a tentative retirement of 'not sooner than June 9, 2027' for claude-mythos-5. This is a restricted, invitation-only model: general marketing pages found online (e.g. anthropic.com/claude/mythos) describe the current Mythos 5.1, not this Mythos 5 snapshot, so claims specific to 5.1 were excluded here.
